answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 4222 Country: India Title: Is it correct to use/hear the good preachings/hadith of different jamats if they are correct.2.Every jamat shows that they are correct at this time whom should we follow.3.What are the symbols that the particular jamat only will go to jannath out of the present various types of jamat i.e. sunni, tabligee, ahle hadis etc Question: Is it correct to use/hear the good preachings/hadith of different jamats if they are correct.2.Every jamat shows that they are correct at this time whom should we follow.3.What are the symbols that the particular jamat only will go to jannath out of the present various types of jamat i.e. sunni, tabligee, ahle hadis etc Answer ID: 4222 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 861/741=B/1429) Just listen and follow t he Jamat which really follows the Holy Quran and Hadith, walks in the footsteps of the Sahaba ( رضی اللہ عنھم ) and past righteous Muslims for example Deobandis and Jamat Tabligh . You need not hear the talks of various Jamats. (2-3) They have already been explained above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
